text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about five hours a week. CRM updates stopped being a Friday-night chore.

2. Notes got better, not just faster. The tool caught pricing objections and next steps that reps used to forget.

3. Adoption hinged on trust. Reps only embraced it once we were clear that recordings wouldn't be used for performance scoring.

4. Customers cared more about consent than we expected. A simple heads-up at the start of every call kept things smooth.

5. Managers coached from real conversations instead of recaps.

The biggest lesson: the tech worked in week one. The habits took the rest of the quarter.

What would you want to know before piloting one?
